title: Binary Search

explanationCitations.quote: Binary search finds target in sorted array in O(log n) time.

useWhen.text: Array is sorted and random access is supported

citations.quote: Requires sorted array and random access.

explanation: An efficient search algorithm that finds an element in a sorted list by repeatedly halving the search interval.

title: Quick Sort

explanationCitations.quote: Quicksort partitions elements around a pivot and sorts partitions recursively.

useWhen.text: General purpose in-place average O(n log n) sorting

explanation: Divide-and-conquer sorting method that partitions an array around a selected pivot and sorts sub-arrays.

title: Merge Sort

explanationCitations.quote: Mergesort divides array into two halves, sorts them, and merges sorted halves.

explanation: Stable divide-and-conquer sorting method that divides input in half and merges sorted sub-lists.

title: Fast Sort

explanationCitations.quote: Fast sort partitions elements around a pivot recursively.

explanation: A partition-based recursive sorting algorithm dividing around a pivot element.

title: Course Agenda and Administrative Details

explanationCitations.quote: Lecture outline: syllabus review, lab office hours, grading policy.

explanation: Lecture outline covering office hours schedule and course grading policies.
